texts.name: Amilcar
texts.biography: It would be easy to dismiss the proud Amilcar of Bull as a mere loudmouth, with more bark than bite. That's a mistake nobody does twice, as few have fought more wars than the aging Duke. He was barely a man when he took part to what was not yet known as the War of the Broken Staff, coming face-to-face with a Darkness that left his hair white and his nights sleepless. Unfortunately, his many qualities and keen tactical mind are too often eclipsed by his raucous and irritable nature.

specialty.name: Torturers
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Torturers and Executioners by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
